who: Eugen Sandow · Strength and How to Obtain It
quote: It is not necessary, as some may think, to be born strong in order to become strong. ... As a child, I was myself exceedingly delicate.
meaning: Sandow was a weak, sick boy until 18. He trained a little every day, and in 1889 he beat a famous strongman.

quote: ...a lame tortoise can go a thousand li by not resting a half step; by heaping up earth and not stopping, a mound or hill can be made high.
meaning: A slow, hurt tortoise can still walk a very long way. It just never stops. Small steps every day add up.

quote: ...genius is one percent inspiration and 99 percent perspiration...
meaning: Perspiration means sweat. His light bulb took thousands of tests. Talent is small. Sweat is big.

quote: Between us and Goodness the gods have placed the sweat of our brows... it is rough at the first; but when a man has reached the top, then is she easy to reach.
meaning: The path is steep and hard at first. Keep sweating and climbing, and one day it feels easy.

who: Gichin Funakoshi · Karate-Do: My Way of Life
quote: I had been a frail, irresolute, introverted child; by the time I reached manhood, I felt myself to be strong, vigorous and outgoing.
meaning: Funakoshi was born early and sickly in 1868. He trained karate at night for years, and in 1922 brought karate to Tokyo.

quote: Nothing great is produced suddenly, since not even the grape or the fig is.
meaning: Great things take time, like fruit on a tree. First the flower, then the fruit.

quote: A small daily task, if it be really daily, will beat the labours of a spasmodic Hercules.
meaning: A little work every day beats big bursts. Writing at 5:30 every morning, Trollope finished 47 novels.

quote: Your pain is the breaking of the shell that encloses your understanding.
meaning: Pain is a shell breaking. Something new is growing inside you.

quote: However difficult life may seem, there is always something you can do and succeed at.
meaning: At 21, an illness began to stop his body. He became one of the great scientists of his time.

quote: No tree which the wind does not often blow against is firm and strong...
meaning: A tree in the wind grows deep roots. Hard times make you strong.
